_about: Models the stand can run on. `file` is relative to models/. Entries with a `url` are downloaded by `models.py fetch NAME`; entries with only a `repo` are converted locally by bin/prepare_model.sh (needs torch). `sha256` is the registry's expected hash of the file; a run records the actual one in its fingerprint either way.

qwen2.5-coder-0.5b.note: Local conversion of the published benchmark's model. The published SHA-256 is the macOS build's; the Linux build differs and is the hash recorded here.

qwen2.5-coder-0.5b-f16.note: The unquantized intermediate of the conversion above.

qwen2.5-coder-1.5b.note: Three times the parameters, to separate 'the language is hard to generate' from 'the model is small'. Local conversion.

qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-f16.note: The unquantized intermediate of the conversion above.

qwen2.5-coder-0.5b-official.note: Qwen's own GGUF release. Larger than the local conversion (491 MB vs 398): a different quantization mix.

qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-official.note: Qwen's own GGUF release; no fp16 is published for 1.5B.
